text: Étain was the mother of Cormac mac Airt. Lore also names her Achtan. Art mac Cuinn, an Irish hero, stayed near a smith before a battle. He learned that any child of Étain would rule Tara. He lay with her in hope of such a son. He asked a friend in Connacht to foster the child. Art went to battle and met his end. After Cormac was born, Étain carried him to Connacht to be fostered. Cormac later claimed the throne of Tara.
